# Intuition Docs (V2)

Version: V2
Scope: V2 covers the packages in the release manifest and Intuition Core.
Package source: https://github.com/0xIntuition/packages/tree/4e9af1373b81a453d16bc650983138e35afb97d1
Core source revision: https://github.com/0xIntuition/intuition-core/tree/a402f880600f92969dc8fb013ca0f69fc9a02420
Other versions: V1 — https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/llms.txt

Start with the system overview and offline quickstart, then follow the guides for your integration. V2 packages and Intuition Core have distinct read, processing, and transaction boundaries. The complete V1 documentation remains available through the other-version index above.

- [llms-full.txt](https://docs.intuition.systems/llms-full.txt): Complete text of the shipped V2 pages
- [llms-medium.txt](https://docs.intuition.systems/llms-medium.txt): Condensed V2 page summaries with metadata

## Start here

- [Intuition V2](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs.md): Choose an application, agent, Core, or plugin development path
- [How the pieces fit](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/get-started/how-it-fits.md): Understand the concept ladder, package layers, and Core services
- [Offline quickstart](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/get-started/quickstart.md): Derive an IID, representation profile, and atom ID without a network connection
- [First on-chain write](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/get-started/first-write.md): Create a testnet atom, deposit, and read the resulting position
- [Choose your packages](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/get-started/choose-packages.md): Map your task to published packages and their references
- [Versions and release status](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/get-started/versions.md): Check exact package pins, source revisions, and installation hazards
- [Migrate from V1](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/get-started/migrate-from-v1.md): Compare APIs and locate replacement pages

## Learn the model

- [Concept map](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/concepts.md): Follow the reading order and distinguish identity, meaning, processing, and writes
- [Representation profiles](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/concepts/representation-profiles.md): Separate canonical profile rules, current builder behavior, and companion metadata
- [Protocol writes](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/concepts/protocol-writes.md): Understand plans, signing, submission, receipts, and indexing

## Build an integration

- [Install packages](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/build/install.md): Select exact package versions and their required peers
- [Creation Profiles](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/build/creation-profiles.md): Inspect classification fields and build typed atom payloads
- [Classify and enrich](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/build/classify-enrich.md): Compose bounded processing and handle partial results
- [Action plans](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/build/action-plans.md): Prepare transaction envelopes before execution
- [Query Core](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/build/query-core.md): Read indexed data through the source-built Core Query API
- [The SDK read client](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/build/read-with-sdk.md): Understand why the hosted V1 client is not a V2 read path
- [Worked examples](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/examples.md): Find the complete music catalog example
- [Music catalog](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/examples/music-catalog.md): Build synthetic identities, predicates, triples, and processing results offline

## Build with agents or extend processing

- [Build with AI agents](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/agents.md): Follow the reading and verification contract before preparing actions
- [Docs for agents](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/agents/docs-for-agents.md): Fetch individual Markdown pages or a version-specific bundle
- [Prepare transactions with the CLI](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/agents/cli.md): Encode calldata for a human to review
- [Agent skills](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/agents/skills.md): Install the intuition and erc8004-agent-layer contract-level skills for V1 and V2
- [Write a classification plugin](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/core/classification-plugin.md): Implement and test a classifier and wire it into a Core source fork

## Look up an API or get help

- [Packages by layer](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/reference/packages.md): Inspect all 21 packages, their runtime graph, and public entry points
- [SDK API reference](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/reference/sdk.md): Read declarations generated from the pinned package source
- [Contracts](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/reference/contracts.md): Find contract responsibilities, deployment addresses, events, errors and audits
- [Networks](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/reference/networks.md): Look up chain IDs, RPC endpoints, explorers and the testnet faucet
- [Compatibility](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/reference/compatibility.md): Check the package, peer, contract, and Core compatibility boundaries
- [Community](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/community.md): Get help and connect with the Intuition community
